projects.title: People, compiled
projects.summary: An assembled, self-contained dashboard for exploring several views of the same fictional people dataset. Open the compiled page to try its chart controls and filters.
projects.context: Compiled static HTML, CSS and local font/texture dependencies. Its inline runtime uses the embedded fictional dataset and makes no network requests.
projects.disclosure: Fictional prototype data. This is not a live Rock connection, a production dashboard, or actual people records.

projects.title: Watershed study
projects.summary: A work-in-progress terrain view exploring a watershed as a visual model for movement and context.
projects.context: Presented as a still image of an in-progress 3D interface study, not a live tool or geographic dataset.
projects.disclosure: WIP / fictional-data prototype. Terrain and labels are illustrative, not geographic facts or measurements.

projects.title: AutoMerge overview
projects.summary: An overview-screen prototype exploring how a review queue and manual merge controls might be organized.
projects.context: A still capture only. The image includes an illustrative Connected state while environment is unknown; neither connection nor thresholds represent verified current behavior.
projects.disclosure: Static prototype capture — not live or connected. States and thresholds in the image are not verified current behavior.
